messages.subject: UnitedHealth Group | Sustainability, resilience and stakeholder execution at enterprise scale
messages.body:
Dear UnitedHealth Group Sustainability Leadership Team,

UnitedHealth Group operates at a scale where sustainability, resilience, public trust and execution across complex stakeholder systems are closely connected.

I currently serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. Across more than 12 years in multinational mining, regulated financial services and commercial operations, I have worked where enterprise strategy meets government, regulators, communities, ESG, reputation and operating continuity.

My value is practical. I lead institutional engagement, translate external expectations into decisions and accountable ownership, coordinate evidence and regulatory follow-through, and help senior leadership manage high-scrutiny stakeholder matters without losing focus on business execution. My current scope spans ESG and sustainability, government relations, corporate and external affairs, social performance, strategic partnerships and executive communications.

UnitedHealth Group’s scale creates a strong context for this leadership profile, particularly in senior market-facing, ESG, external affairs, stakeholder, corporate responsibility or strategic partnership mandates. I am internationally mobile and available on a 30-day notice period.

I have attached my executive CV. If there is a senior mandate where this combination of institutional leadership, stakeholder trust and execution would add value, I would welcome a conversation or referral to the appropriate executive talent leader.

messages.subject: The Home Depot | Responsible sourcing, community trust and sustainable growth
messages.body:

The Home Depot’s sustainability model reaches far beyond facilities. It extends into products, suppliers, communities, responsible sourcing and the operating choices that determine whether growth creates durable value.

That combination aligns strongly with my leadership experience.

I currently serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. Across more than 12 years, I have worked across government relations, ESG, corporate affairs, social performance, community engagement, compliance coordination and executive stakeholder strategy.

My operating discipline is built around one question: how do you turn a public commitment into measurable delivery across multiple internal owners and external stakeholders? I coordinate regulators, government institutions, communities and business teams, assign actions and evidence requirements, surface risks early, and drive closure on sensitive matters.

For The Home Depot, this experience is relevant to responsible sourcing, supplier-country engagement, sustainability, community resilience, external affairs and international stakeholder strategy. It is especially relevant where global supply chains meet environmental standards, community expectations and government policy.

I have attached my executive CV. I would welcome consideration for senior roles where The Home Depot needs stronger alignment between responsible growth, stakeholder trust and execution.
